newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela candidate for sainthood appears in X-ray.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela candidate for sainthood appears in X-ray.

text.p: Venezuelan doctors were baffled on Thursday by an image of a revered doctor and candidate for sainthood that appeared in an X-ray of a boy's stomach.

They said the ghostly image bore a striking resemblance to Dr. Jose Gregorio Hernandez, a bowler-hatted 19th-century doctor who healed the poor for free and is credited by many Venezuelans with miraculous powers.
"It may have been gases in his stomach but the image on the X-rays is very clear ... of a man with a moustache dressed in a suit," said Dr. Guiseppe Ferraloto, who treated the boy.

The X-rays were taken after 10-year-old Alejandro Cuadra was rushed to a hospital with back pains on Monday in Maracay in central Venezuela. He was later released, apparently fit and well, Ferraloto said.

Jose Gregorio, the first person to be killed in a car accident in Venezuela, was run over in 1919. Despite petitions by leaders of Venezuela's Roman Catholic Church, he has yet to be beatified by the Vatican, the first step towards sainthood.
